title: Wire the instruments render suite by named file; keep the migration byte-scan held for T-789's gated half

scope.judgedWhole: Every test file in the directory is a row. Once one of two runs, the directory is PARTIAL and leaves the dark-directory ratchet's set, so that ratchet can no longer see a third file added beside them. The control pins the directory's on-disk file set to this record in its place.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with `npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci` on base b274987ddc: 2 of 2 green (2 and 3 cases).

wiring.step: Run the T-789 instruments render suite by named file
wiring.whyByFile: Naming the directory would also select instrument-data-layer-migration.test.ts, which asserts literals over the bytes of an applied migration. Whether to keep, rewrite or retire it is T-789's gated half.

gatedHalf.decision: Keep src/lib/instruments/__tests__/instrument-data-layer-migration.test.ts as a byte assertion over an immutable applied migration, rewrite it over the migrated schema, or retire its literal cases and keep only the scanForDestructivePatterns case.
gatedHalf.status: decision needed — not taken by this record
